limitations: All original native RECORD digests and METADATA/WHEEL match official publisher wheels. Some staged Mach-O files changed during sanitization/signing; bit-identical source rebuilds are not claimed.
The 243 exact registry input archives come from four matching source Cargo.lock files, including optional/test/build/other-target inputs; their presence does not prove Mac linkage.
Tiktoken 0.14.0 has no publisher Cargo.lock; its existing declared candidates do not confirm compiled transitive versions.
numpy/onnxruntime wheel tags require macosx_14_0_arm64 and orjson macosx_15_0_arm64. OpenCV deployment target 13.0 is not the minimum of the whole runtime.
